thread_text:
Nora Kim: Hi all 1f44b Hi! Nora here, joining Eng-Platform today. Laptop arrived but I can't enroll in Jamf and VPN returns auth error. Who do I ping for Git org access / SSH key review? Also, two truths and a lie for icebreakers: 1) I once ran a half-marathon in Tokyo, 2) I can make latte art, 3) I have a pet tarantula named Luna. Guess which is the lie?

Diego Vega: Welcome Nora!! 389 I'm your manager. I'll loop in IT and assign a buddy. For Git access ping @Asha and for VPN @Marta. Friday team breakfast?

Marta (IT): Hey Nora, Marta from IT. Can you DM device serial and OS? If Jamf email didn't arrive, I'll resend and manually approve. For VPN, which client did you install? Link: https://intranet.redwood/vpn-client

Nora Kim: macOS Ventura, serial C02QZ12XYZ45. I installed the client from the link but auth fails with "certificate not trusted". Jamf email not in spam either.

Marta (IT): Thanks 44b I'll reissue the Jamf invite and push the CA cert to your device once enrolled. Meanwhile try this command to check certs: `scutil --get SystemKeychain` and paste output if it errors.

Asha Patel: Hi Nora! I'm your onboarding buddy. For Git org access, generate an SSH key and paste the pub key into the new-hire form or DM me. Example:

Asha Patel: ```
ssh-keygen -t ed25519 -C "nora.kim@redwood.com"
cat ~/.ssh/id_ed25519.pub
```

Nora Kim: Dropping the pub key in the form now. Also re: the icebreaker I'm not brave enough for a tarantula 62c so I *think* that's the lie.

Riley - ops: Welcome Nora! If you need any infra quickstarts, ping me. Also stickers: we have a "welcome pack" with stickers + a hoodie. DM mailing address to Marta.

HR Bot: Reminder 514 - Complete benefits enrollment and payroll forms within 72 hours: https://intranet.redwood/onboarding

Nora Kim: Quick update: Jamf invite arrived 44b enrolled device & Marta approved. VPN certificate fixed after Marta pushed cert. SSH key added and I have repo access. Thank you! Also confirmed the lie was the tarantula 609. Looking forward to the breakfast Friday 375

Diego Vega: Awesome, welcome officially! We'll do a short onboarding walkthrough tomorrow and intro to team's repos. See you at breakfast 374
